description: What is the housing picture for an Irish area? Paid ($0.05 USDC): one bundle with the rent benchmark and 4- and 12-quarter trend, rent-control summary, county rent ranking context and county sale-price comps summary (CSO/RTB RIQ02, PSRA). This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://rent-check-production.up.railway.app/v1/ie-housing-report. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL.
